entities.summary: Subha Nagalakshmi Munchetty-Chendriah, known professionally as Naga Munchetty, is a British television presenter, newsreader and journalist. She is a regular presenter on BBC Breakfast, and hosts an 11am–2pm programme from Monday to Wednesday on BBC Radio 5 Live, including "Must Watch with Scott Bryan and Hayley Campbell" on Mondays. She is also a former presenter of BBC World News and BBC Two's weekday financial affairs programme Working Lunch.
